sections.title: Universe

lines: New rotation: RS composite ≥ 40, rotation RS ≥ 80, rotation spread ≥ 15.
SHORT promotion beyond WATCH is disabled.

Established strength OR the complete new-rotation branch qualifies; a failed alternative does not veto a passing branch. Rotation delta is the cross-sectional RS rotation minus RS composite, not historical movement.

sections.title: Market regime

lines: Signed (close − SMA50) / Wilder ATR14; entry range 0 to 4.8 ATR inclusive.
Bands: below 0; entry < 3; healthy < 5; extended < 7; extreme ≥ 7.
sections.title: Extension

lines: Confirmed or estimated events at distances 0 through 5 exchange sessions block ACT.
Empty event lists require complete fresh coverage. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN.
sections.title: Earnings

lines: Base risk budget: 0.25% of account equity. Regime multipliers: GREEN 1×; YELLOW 0.5×; RED 0×. UNKNOWN does not authorize a size.
Whole shares = floor(allowed risk / stop distance); pilot = floor(shares / 3).
Optional default stop: entry ± 1.6 × Wilder ATR14. Entry and trade stop remain caller proposals.
Capital constraint = min(risk-based shares, floor(buying power / entry)).
